name: Nuro
sub: The Nuro Driver, licensed from delivery pods to Lucid SUVs
leadership: Jiajun Zhu and Dave Ferguson, co-founders and co-CEOs
about: Autonomy company that pivoted from their own compact delivery vehicles toward licensing the Nuro Driver into third-party vehicles such as Lucid Gravity.
model: Technology licensing, AV stack supply, and strategic robotaxi partnerships.
financing: Late-stage private; $6B valuation reported in 2025 funding
deployment: Licensing the Nuro Driver: Uber–Lucid robotaxi program with 75 engineering vehicles delivered, a modified California driverless testing permit (May 2026), SF employee testing under way, Bay Area commercial service targeted late 2026 and Houston mid-2027.
metrics: $203M funding at $6B valuation reported; Uber/Lucid production-intent vehicle debuted at CES 2026
signal: Nuro is now more valuable as a vehicle-agnostic autonomy supplier than as a delivery-pod manufacturer.

sources.title: Nuro announces Series E financing at $6B valuation, backed by leading financial and strategic investors
